summary: Washington County, OR: a temporary 1931 platform in three trees, about 50 ft; abandoned in the 1950s or removed, date unknown; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Temporary platform built in the tops of three trees, about 50 feet above the ground
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists it as removed with no date; firelookout.com says it was abandoned in the 1950s

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says 15 miles northwest; the Forest Lookouts page, quoting a 1938 newspaper item and the 1935 survey description, says 16 miles north. The story gives both.
Firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1950s; the Forest Lookouts page says removed, with no date. Both can be true, since abandonment could come before removal. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two web sources give the fate differently (abandoned 1950s; removed, undated). No removal year, so no removed or abandoned event is recorded. Firelookout.com gives elevation 2038 ft; not recorded because no fact key takes it. The Forest Lookouts page notes 1936 panorama photos by S.L.M.; not used because they are not available to us. Access and visit fields left out: no source describes the site now. Forest Lookouts names the agency as ODF Tillamook FPA; the story repeats that wording rather than expanding the FPA.
